name: Bell Yard supported approach, third person
expression: async()=>{const r=Realm.test.move(-12,-79);if(!r.ok)throw Error(r.error);await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const start=performance.now();const t=setInterval(()=>{if(!Realm.test.path.length){clearInterval(t);resolve();}else if(performance.now()-start>90000){clearInterval(t);reject(Error('Real approach timed out'));}},100);});return {player:Realm.diagnostics.adventure.player,enemy:Realm.diagnostics.adventure.enemies.find(e=>e.id==='hell-tithe-warden-v1')};}
